display_long_description:
🌍 Big Big Walk VR

Welcome to Big Big Walk VR! Step into a huge open world and experience the simple joy of exploring in Big Big Walk VR! Put on your headset, start walking, keep jumping, and see just how far your adventure can take you. There are no complicated mechanics - just you, and your big walk... it's time to take a step and a big walk!

Whether you're looking for a relaxing VR experience or simply want to enjoy the feeling of movement in a giant environment, Big Big Walk VR lets you wander at your own pace. Walk across endless fields, climb steep hills, jump over obstacles, and discover scenic viewpoints as you immerse yourself in virtual reality.

🚶 Explore a Massive World

Every direction offers somewhere new to go. From wide open landscapes to hidden locations waiting to be found, there's always another place to explore.

🦘 Jump, Climb & Keep Moving

Master your movement by jumping across gaps, climbing natural terrain, and reaching places that reward curious explorers.

🥽 Built for Virtual Reality

Experience smooth and immersive VR gameplay designed to make exploration feel natural and enjoyable. Every step brings you deeper into the world.

🌄 Relax and Explore

Take your time, enjoy the scenery, and experience a peaceful world where exploration is the main objective. Perfect for players who enjoy relaxing VR adventures.

✨ Features
🚶 Freedom to walk wherever you want
🦘 Fun jumping and traversal mechanics
🏔️ Hills, valleys to climb
